# openrouter.ai documentation

> Move agent toolkit imports from @openrouter/sdk to the standalone @openrouter/agent package

Generated from a mirror of openrouter.ai by docset_refine on the hub; 283 pages. Companion files: llms-full.txt (all pages), llms-small.txt (reference pages within ~50k tokens), llms-facts.txt (extracted units).

## Sections

- [Agent Sdk](agent-sdk/llms.txt): 21 pages, ~1,104 tokens — Migrating to @openrouter/agent, Agent SDK API Reference, Async Tools and 18 more
- [Api Reference](api-reference/llms.txt): 14 pages, ~633 tokens — Authentication, Embeddings, Errors and Debugging and 11 more
- [Overview](overview/llms.txt): 4 pages, ~194 tokens — App Attribution, Batch API Quickstart, Frequently Asked Questions and 1 more
- [Client Sdks](client-sdks/llms.txt): 92 pages, ~4,430 tokens — Migrating to @openrouter/agent, DevTools, OpenRouter Go SDK and 89 more
- [Cookbook](cookbook/llms.txt): 46 pages, ~2,337 tokens — Activity Export, Control Costs with the Analytics API, API Key Rotation and 43 more
- [Guides](guides/llms.txt): 104 pages, ~4,576 tokens — Latency and Performance, Prompt Caching, Reasoning Tokens and 101 more
